releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.2 (Professional Video Cutter, Real Multi-Platform Downloader & Lossless MP4 Export)
releaseNotes:
• Dedicated CapCut-Style Video Cutter: Large video preview player, horizontal visual timeline with real frame thumbnails, draggable start/end handles, frame-by-frame -0.1s/+0.1s navigation, and lossless MP4 export
• Full Video Clipping: Cut any duration (15s Reel, 30s TikTok, 60s Story, or Custom 00:35 - 01:20) with audio synchronization
• Real Facebook & YouTube Engine: Direct public MP4 streams with authentic resolutions (360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, 2K, 4K) without fake mock samples
• Library Integration: Rename, cut, play, and share trimmed clips and full downloads directly from Library
• Strict Production Keystore: Guaranteed update compatibility signed with CN=TikSave (SHA-256: 83:D5:31:82...)
